The Challenges of Running a Restaurant in Pakistan

Running a restaurant in Pakistan can be challenging, especially when it comes to managing finances and ensuring FBR compliance. With the constant need to update your menu, manage inventory, and handle customer transactions, it can be difficult to keep track of your finances and ensure that you are meeting all the necessary regulations.

Moreover, the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has implemented various regulations, such as SRO 1006 and SRO 673, that restaurants must comply with. Failure to comply with these regulations can result in penalties and fines, which can be detrimental to your business.

That's where Phelix ERP's restaurant billing software comes in. Our solution is designed to help you manage your restaurant operations efficiently, while ensuring FBR compliance. With our software, you can focus on providing excellent customer service and growing your business, without worrying about the complexities of FBR regulations.
